tagline: Audiovisual Intelligence & Operational Production Operating System
description: ABRAXAS OS is an integrated operating system unifying content intelligence, operational workflow governance, and deterministic audiovisual synthesis.
whatItIs: An integrated content intelligence and operational AV operating system.
A local-first, deterministic production pipeline bridging editorial concepts with render engines.
A unified task, approval, deadline, and time tracking operational core (He).
A non-destructive cuts and programmatic visual motion synthesis engine (VAV).
whatItIsNot: Not a generic project management SaaS wrapper.
Not a simple third-party AI chatbot prompt wrapper.
Not an automated spam publishing bot.

modules.name: Yod
modules.responsibility: Maintains content pattern registries, hook and CTA taxonomies, narrative structures, and forensic provenance truth.
modules.statusDetail: Pattern and format registries verified locally.

modules.name: Lienzo
modules.responsibility: Provides persistent, versioned content identity and structured semantic composition as Source of Truth per content piece.
modules.statusDetail: Canonical schema and authoring contracts frozen.

modules.name: He
modules.responsibility: Manages tasks, assignments, dependencies, operational blockers, Kanban projections, production calendars, recording sessions, approvals, time tracking, and notification center.
modules.statusDetail: Operations Core, Persistent Store, Product UI, Time Tracking, and Notifications verified.

modules.name: Shim
modules.responsibility: Observes real media sources, performs checksum verification, resolves candidate assets, and ensures evidence integrity.
modules.statusDetail: Storage and asset candidate observation contract frozen.

modules.name: VAV
modules.responsibility: Executes non-destructive multi-segment cutting via local FFmpeg, frame-accurate Remotion motion compositions, caption compilation, and platform safe-zone validations.
modules.statusDetail: Cut Engine, Motion Engine, Remotion Composition, and Platform Safe Zones verified.

modules.name: Arquitecto
modules.responsibility: Consumes Yod criteria and system state to provide architectural guidance; powers the deterministic Public Architect V1 responder.
modules.statusDetail: Public Architect V1 guide verified locally; private reasoning runtime in specification.

modules.name: Pipeline Engine
modules.responsibility: Coordinates multi-stage asset generation, offline compilation, and rendering pipelines.
modules.statusDetail: Batch execution specification scheduled for future gate.

modules.name: AI Runtime
modules.responsibility: Executes controlled LLM and vision inference across local/hybrid providers with strict prompt boundaries.
modules.statusDetail: Provider dispatch interface scheduled for future gate.

modules.name: Publishing
modules.responsibility: Packages approved master media with platform metadata for distribution.
modules.statusDetail: Distribution gateway scheduled for future gate.

modules.name: Metrics
modules.responsibility: Collects engagement signals to close the feedback loop back into Yod pattern criteria (target loop).
modules.statusDetail: Telemetry feedback scheduled for future gate.

relationships.description: Provides content patterns, hooks, and forensic criteria for authoring.
Supplies structured scenes and components requiring production tasks and approvals.
Dispatches approved tasks and edit locks to render cut and motion deliverables.
Observes real media assets and binds candidate files to scene components.
Delivers rendered video files and compiled captions for packaging.
Feeds platform performance telemetry back into criteria registries (Target Loop).
Supplies criteria and system contracts to architectural guidance models.

qaPairs.answerEn: ABRAXAS OS is an integrated operating system uniting content intelligence (Yod), team workflow operations (He), and deterministic video synthesis (VAV).
qaPairs.answerEs: ABRAXAS OS es un sistema operativo integrado que une inteligencia de contenido (Yod), operaciones de flujo de trabajo (He) y síntesis de video determinista (VAV).

qaPairs.answerEn: Yod is the intelligence domain maintaining structured content pattern registries, hook taxonomies, and forensic provenance criteria.
qaPairs.answerEs: Yod es el dominio de inteligencia que mantiene registros estructurados de patrones de contenido, taxonomías de ganchos y criterios de procedencia forense.

qaPairs.answerEn: Lienzo is the persistent authoring identity canvas serving as the immutable Source of Truth for scene structures and creative components.
qaPairs.answerEs: Lienzo es el lienzo de identidad de autoría persistente que sirve como Fuente de Verdad inmutable para estructuras de escenas y componentes creativos.

qaPairs.answerEn: He is the operations core governing tasks, assignments, typed blocker dependencies, multi-reviewer approvals, production calendars, time tracking, and notification routing.
qaPairs.answerEs: He es el núcleo de operaciones que gobierna tareas, asignaciones, dependencias bloqueantes tipadas, aprobaciones multi-revisor, calendarios de producción, registro de tiempo y enrutamiento de notificaciones.

qaPairs.answerEn: Shim observes real external media sources and verifies checksums and candidate assets for safe pipeline consumption.
qaPairs.answerEs: Shim observa fuentes de medios externos reales y verifica sumas de comprobación y activos candidatos para un consumo seguro en el pipeline.

qaPairs.answerEn: VAV is the production audiovisual synthesis engine executing non-destructive FFmpeg multi-segment cuts, Remotion motion graphics, and platform safe-zone validations.
qaPairs.answerEs: VAV es el motor de producción de síntesis audiovisual que ejecuta cortes multi-segmento no destructivos con FFmpeg, gráficos de movimiento con Remotion y validaciones de zonas seguras.

qaPairs.answerEn: Arquitecto provides contextual architecture guidance and powers the deterministic Public Architect V1 responder.
qaPairs.answerEs: Arquitecto proporciona orientación contextual sobre la arquitectura del sistema y alimenta el respondedor determinista Public Architect V1.

qaPairs.questionEs: ¿Cuál es la hoja de ruta de ABRAXAS?
qaPairs.answerEn: The roadmap consists of Gates P1 (VAV AV Core), P2 (He Operations Core), P3A (He UI Core), P3B (Time & Notifications), P4 (Public Status & Public Architect), and P5 (Integrated Release).
qaPairs.answerEs: La hoja de ruta comprende las Fases P1 (Núcleo AV VAV), P2 (Núcleo Operativo He), P3A (Interfaz He), P3B (Tiempo y Notificaciones), P4 (Estado Público y Arquitecto Público) y P5 (Lanzamiento Integrado).

qaPairs.questionEn: What works now in ABRAXAS OS?
qaPairs.answerEn: Currently verified local: VAV non-destructive cuts & Remotion motions, He Operations Core & Product UI (Solo Queue, Kanban, Calendar, Deadlines, Recordings, Time Tracking, Notifications), and Public Status V2 / Public Architect V1.
qaPairs.answerEs: Actualmente verificado localmente: cortes no destructivos y movimiento Remotion de VAV, Núcleo Operativo e Interfaz de He (Solo Queue, Kanban, Calendario, Deadlines, Grabaciones, Registro de Tiempo, Notificaciones) y Estado Público V2 / Arquitecto Público V1.

qaPairs.questionEn: How do He and VAV relate?
qaPairs.answerEn: He manages operational workflow, tasks, assignments, and approvals for video projects, while VAV provides the audiovisual engine executing non-destructive cuts and programmatic motion renders.
qaPairs.answerEs: He gestiona el flujo de trabajo operativo, tareas, asignaciones y aprobaciones para proyectos de video, mientras que VAV proporciona el motor audiovisual que ejecuta cortes no destructivos y renders de movimiento programático.
